title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E04 — We All Fall...
The team continue to investigate the murder of an officer who was about to blow the whistle on police misconduct; Pride must get creative in order to finally get rid of the dirty cops; the mayor asks Pride to join her new task force.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E05 — Operation Drano, Part I
The team investigates a suspicious death and the missing key piece of evidence is a top secret, high-tech battery; Pride and the team realize there could be deadly consequences if it falls into the wrong hands.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E06 — Operation Drano, Part II
When a torpedo hits a fishing trawler at sea, the entire Gulf Coast is in jeopardy as Pride and NCIS race to find the submarine before it can strike again.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E07 — Leda and the Swan, Part I
A Navy therapist who is working to get justice for victims of sexual assault is murdered; Carter's mother confronts him when he refuses to talk to the FBI for a background check on her behalf.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E08 — Leda and the Swan, Part II
As Pride and the team continue the investigation of an officer's assault and the murder of her therapist, NCIS zeroes in on a suspect who's been working the system for years; Carter and his mother talk about how they'll move forward after a mistake.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E09 — Into Thin Air
Pride and the team are on the hunt for a kidnapped 14-year-old and discover that her father, who will soon have custody of her, is a radical survivalist living off the grid.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E10 — Homeward Bound
When a petty officer is shot down by a sniper, Pride and NCIS hunt down the killer, only to find that he may not be acting alone; Rita tells Pride that she has been offered a compelling job.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E12 — A Christmas Car-Roll
On Christmas Eve, Walter becomes unconscious after falling down the stairs and enters a dream world where Team Scorpion never existed.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E13 — The Bunker Games
The team must work with Toby's nemesis and his wife -- Toby's ex-fiancée -- when they are locked inside an artificially intelligent doomsday bunker that aims to kill them; Walter is distracted by a dream in which he married Florence instead of Paige.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E14 — Lighthouse of the Rising Sun
Power is knocked out in Los Angeles, and the team must help a teen pilot and his girlfriend who are lost over the Pacific without any radio contact; Walter must look after a group of Ralph's classmates; Cabe tries to tell Allie that he loves her.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E15 — Wave Goodbye
Team Scorpion must prevent an incoming tsunami from hitting a vulnerable nuclear power facility; Toby secretly helps his ex-fiancee retrieve her stolen identity.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E02 — Na La 'ilio
McGarrett and the team work with an injured police dog that is the only witness to an ambushed drug bust; a former SEAL looks to join the task force.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E03 — Kau Pahi, Ko'u Kua. Kau Pu, Ko'u Po'O.
The team enlists an old friend when a crime boss is murdered, triggering revenge killings across the island; McGarrett and Danny work out details concerning their new restaurant venture.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E04 — E Uhi Wale No 'A'Ole E Nalo, He Imu Puhi
When the HPD system is hacked and one of the Five-0's informants ends up dead, McGarrett enlists the help of hacker Aaron Wright, whom he just imprisoned.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E05 — Kama'oma'o, Ka 'Aina Huli Hana
At Halloween, the team investigates a string of murders that mirrors stories from well-known Hawaiian folklore; Grover visits a man who is hours away from execution and may hold the key to a case that has plagued Grover for years.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E06 — Mohala I Ka Wai Ka Maka O Ka Pua
The murder of two tourists leads the team to a man who has multiple personality disorder; Danny and the others hire a stress management consultant to help McGarrett.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E07 — Kau Ka 'Onohi Ali'i I Luna
A bank heist in progress forces Steve to make a potentially heartbreaking mistake; Adam faces an empty home without Kono.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E08 — He Kaha Lu'u Ke Ala, Mai Ho'okolo Aku
McGarrett poses as a pilot to investigate a plane crash that led to the death of a pilot in an air race.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E09 — Make Me Kai
McGarrett, Danny, Tani, and Junior are exposed to a deadly biological weapon; the rest of the team has eight hours to find an antidote.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E10 — I Ka Wa Ma Mua, I Ka Wa Ma Hope
Danny is shot while quarantined in the hospital; unconscious, he clings to life and imagines a future for everyone.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E11 — Oni Kalalea Ke Ku a Ka La'au Loa
Danny tells Charlie a bedtime story about a case involving bad Santas and a holiday miracle.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E12 — Ka Hopu Nui 'Ana
When an FBI agent who was cracking down on organized crime is killed, McGarrett rounds up every gang-related criminal on the island to find the culprit responsible for the murder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E13 — O Ka Mea Ua Hala, Ua Hala Ia.
Grover must prevent a man who is accused of killing his wife from committing suicide.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E14 — Na Keiki a Kalaihaohia
The corpse of a diamond smuggler is stolen from a graveyard; Five-0 tracks down his partner, who is determined to retrieve their latest batch of contraband; Adam recruits a new, confidential informant; Tani gets a devastating call.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E15 — He Puko'a Kani 'Aina
McGarrett and Danny investigate the murder of a private detective whose client was killed the same way; Adam sends Jessie into a dangerous situation with disastrous consequences; Danny's uncle comes to town to help with the restaurant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E16 — O Na Hoku O Ka Lani Wale No Kai 'Ike I Kahi O Pae
Tani and Junior go undercover as prospective parents to infiltrate a private school where the headmaster was murdered; Adam's life is on the line when he is held captive and forced to produce a massive amount of money.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E17 — Holapu Ke Ahi, Koe Iho Ka Lehu
Adam's mission to take down organized crime goes sideways when the bait he uses falls into the wrong hands; Adam begins to doubt Jessie's allegiance.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E18 — E Ho'oko Kuleana
The ex-wife of the man who shot Danny reveals how Danny helped save her life; Tani and Junior are assigned to walk the beat as uniformed officers for the day; Adam is framed for the murder of the crime boss he has been tracking.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E19 — Aohe Mea Make I Ka Hewa; Make No I Ka Mihi Ole
A hit man McGarrett's father failed to arrest comes to McGarrett to finally confess his crimes and admit where he buried his victims; Jessie makes a dangerous decision that could ruin Adam's life.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E20 — He Lokomaika'i Ka Manu O Kaiona
Catherine Rollins recruits McGarrett and Jerry to help track down uranium thought to be hidden on an abandoned Hawaiian island before a terrorist makes dirty bombs with it; Junior gets trapped in a ravine.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E21 — Ahuwale Ka Nane Huna
Harry Langford enlists McGarrett and Danny's help to track down a teenage British royal who has run away while under his protection; Grover, Tani and Junior work a 25-year-old murder case after a mysterious videotape arrives at headquarters.

title: MacGyver
description:

MacGyver uses a cell phone and soccer ball in the search for a Navy SEAL who is believed to be held captive in the Middle East.

title: MacGyver
description:

Riley disappears during her first solo mission; Mac and the team attempt to locate her.

title: MacGyver
description:

MacGyver and the team must steal diamonds before terrorists beat them to it and trade the jewels for a weapon of mass destruction.

title: MacGyver
description:

When Murdoc drugs and kidnaps MacGyver, Mac must escape and join the team to save Murdoc's next victim.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E05 — Skull + Electromagnet
The team's Halloween plans are interrupted when the vice president's son's plane goes down with a mysterious prisoner on board.

title: MacGyver
description:

Mac and the team attempt to extinguish a massive oil wellhead fire set by a rebel group in Nigeria.

title: MacGyver
description:

MacGyver uses a heater and hot sauce to help a key presidential candidate in Ecuador receive a heart transplant he desperately needs after a rebel group tries to sabotage delivery of the organ.

title: MacGyver
description:

MacGyver and Jack "steal" a priceless painting to draw out an infamous stolen art dealer; Riley's estranged father asks to be part of her life; Matty sends Bozer to a spy training camp.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The team investigates unusual murders in Los Angeles, and more information about Prentiss' past arises.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU heads to upstate New York to investigate mysterious disappearances; Prentiss receives troubling news about a former colleague.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

Reid's ability to connect with an autistic child may prove helpful in finding the boy's missing parents; two former colleagues help Prentiss search for an old adversary.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

After a series of murders, Prentiss becomes suspicious of a former nemesis (Sebastian Roché) and fears for the safety of her team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

Prentiss prepares to confront her nemesis at last; the team asks J.J. to help find Prentiss and capture Doyle.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E19 — With Friends Like These ...
The team must stop a gang of suspected murderers that is targeting a new victim nightly.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E20 — Hanley Waters
The team must investigate targeted killings in Florida while each member is dealing with feelings about losing Prentiss.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E21 — The Stranger
A stalker in San Diego targets college students; Strauss scrutinizes the team after the loss of Prentiss.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E22 — Out of the Light
The team travels to a North Carolina town where one woman was found badly injured and another is missing, and discovers those may not be the only victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E23 — Big Sea
The team investigates when bodies are found buried beneath the ocean floor off Florida; Morgan is rattled when his aunt thinks her missing daughter is one of the victims.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S06 E24 — Supply & Demand
The team investigates a suspected human trafficking ring; Hotchner suggests changes are coming; J.J. returns to the team.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E01 — It Takes a Village
A Senate committee questions the members of the BAU team; a familiar face may help keep the team united.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E02 — Proof
The BAU team investigates a series of murders in Oklahoma; Reid gives JJ and Prentiss the cold shoulder.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

After a mass murder at an Internet security company, evidence indicates that the person responsible is not a typical serial killer; Prentiss is required to complete recertification training.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E04 — Painless
A killer targets survivors of a high-school massacre, who have gathered for a reunion; Hotch fears that his son is being bullied.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E05 — From Childhood's Hour
A series of children are abducted from troubled women in St. Louis; Rossi's first wife shares shocking news.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E02 — Cold Case Blues
Toby struggles with Alvin Klein during his first official investigation: a 10-year-old murder.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E03 — Curtain Call
A performer's life is threatened, so Toby poses as her assistant and helps to investigate.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E04 — The Taking
An African teenager, whose father is an alleged war criminal, is abducted.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E05 — Rogues' Gallery
Toby's telepathy acts as surveillance when Michelle goes undercover to expose an art-theft ring.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E02 — Espionage
A client is on trial for going public with classified government documents; Bull experiences emotional turmoil following his daughter's kidnapping.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E03 — Bull Undone
TAC represents a man charged with his high school girlfriend's murder after a documentary depicts him as the prime suspect in the decades-old homicide.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E04 — Uneasy Lies the Crown
Bull faces uncertainty in court when TAC handles a class action suit against a vaping company selling malfunctioning devices; Marissa takes the initiative when Bull ignores TAC's growing financial difficulties.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E05 — King Bull
The team asks Bull to step aside, when they fear his recent issues could negatively affect their defense of a business mogul accused of being mentally unfit to lead his company.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E06 — Better Angels
Bull has just two days to prepare a defense for a midwife accused of practicing without a license; the team tries to convince the private religious community of women their client helps to serve as character witnesses.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E07 — Confidence Man
Bull's legal troubles go from professional to personal when new evidence in his bribery trial implicates his wife; the TAC team's efforts to assist Bull in court are thwarted by his attorney, who fears they will cross a legal line to help their boss.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E08 — Snowed In
Bull needs a Christmas miracle when he takes on a sports agency's young assistant charged with providing a star client lethal drugs.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E09 — False Positive
Bull helps a grieving mother sue the developers of a computer program that misidentified her son as a criminal, leading him to be fatally shot by the police; Bull and Marissa clash when she considers a job offer from a rival company.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E03 — The Prince in the Plastic
Booth and Sweets are given access to a toy company's headquarters after an executive's remains are found packaged with a Prince Charming doll; Sweets prepares for his gun certification test; Brennan worries about motherhood.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E04 — The Male in the Mail
After dismembered remains are found in multiple mailing boxes, the team uncovers a complicated love triangle; Booth's grandfather reveals surprising news; Special Agent Genny Shaw (Tina Majorino) learns how important teamwork is.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E05 — The Twist in the Twister
The team suspects murder when a storm chaser is killed while filming a tornado; Booth becomes increasingly protective of Brennan.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E06 — The Crack in the Code
After a cryptic message written in human blood is found at a national monument, the team ends up embarking on a scavenger hunt; Brennan and Booth search for their perfect family home.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E07 — The Prisoner in the Pipe
When the remains of an escaped convict are found in the sewer, the investigation reveals the man died in prison; Brennan gives birth in unconventional circumstances.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E08 — The Bump in the Road
When an extreme couponer's remains are found on the side of a road, the investigation leads the team to the supermarket where she shopped; Brennan adjusts to being at work and away from her baby; Cam is unhappy with her daughter's choice of suitors.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E09 — The Don't in the Do
A corpse that has been dyed blue is found in a landfill; when Bones feels uncomfortable in her post-baby body, Booth tries to boost her self-confidence.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E10 — The Warrior in the Wuss
Booth and Brennan investigate the death of a truck company employee whose body is found in the woods; Hodgins buys new lab equipment; Brennan worries about Parker's return from England.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E11 — The Family in the Feud
When a corpse is discovered in the woods, the team considers two families involved in a nearly century-long feud; Brennan is apprehensive when her father (Ryan O'Neal) offers to baby-sit for her daughter.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E12 — The Suit on the Set
While in Los Angeles to consult on a film based on her latest book, Brennan discovers the prop cadaver being used is a murder victim; Booth gets a job offer; embarrassing information about Cam's past comes out.

title: Bones
description:
S07 E13 — The Past in the Present
When a past suspect is back in court on appeal, Booth and Brennan work to prove he is guilty once and for all; Brennan becomes a suspect.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E01 — The Future in the Past
After Brennan is accused of murder, her father (Ryan O'Neal) helps her hide from the FBI; Booth and the team think an evil tech genius (Andrew Leeds) manipulated evidence to implicate Brennan.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E05 — The Paranormal Hacktivity Job
When a woman believes she is being haunted, Sophie leads Breanna and Parker through a con to convince the two real estate scammers responsible to target Leverage HQ.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E06 — The Card Game Job
The Leverage team dives into the world of a fantasy collectible card game with a devoted following to take down a pharmaceutical bad boy who is price-gouging drugs.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E07 — The Double-Edged Sword Job
The team takes on a brilliant software developer who is selling a facial recognition system that threatens everyone's privacy except his own.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E08 — The Mastermind Job
Sophie must keep her feelings in check when she discovers that someone has written a memoir of the team, casting himself as Nate.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S12 E18 — Hell's Kitchen
The BAU investigates an urban vampire who kidnaps his victims at night and holds them underground in the sewer system; Reid makes a difficult decision in prison.

title: Criminal Minds
description:

The BAU is called to investigate after three victims are discovered tied to stakes in the brutal Arizona desert.
